story: Mac and the Micro – memories of Ian McNaught-Davis
text: I loved that programme and I loved my Model B. Serle & Mac were so easy to watch. It was on BBC2 (then so were a bunch of great early morning Open University programmes on subjects that were way over my young head). [VIDEO] Wasn't there also a weekly Radio 4 computer programme where they'd transmit a program that you could record on tape and then load onto your computer?

story: The man with a Home Computer (1967) [video]
text: That man, Rex Malik, participated in (among other things) the 1982 BBC series “The Computer Programme” ( [LINK] ), typically in a small section at the end on an episode but also as narrator in other parts and is credited as “Programme Adviser”: Episode 1 - “It’s Happening Now”: [VIDEO] Episode 4 - “It’s on the Computer”: [LINK] Episode 5 - “The New Media“: [LINK] Episode 10 - “Things to Come”: [LINK]
